create_batched_streetlearn: create a BatchedStreetLearn environment with multiple shared-cache environments for batched RL training
run_step_batched: run a step in all batched StreetLearn environments and return batched observations, rewards, done flags, and info
reset_batched_env: reset all environments in a batched StreetLearn instance to start new episodes
get_batched_observations: get batched observations including view images and graph images across all environments
goto_pano_batched: go to a specific panorama and yaw in a single environment within the batched StreetLearn instance
